::: {#sol-seed-spread}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
wide_scores = torch.tensor([train_and_score(64, 0.1, seed)[-1] for seed in range(10)])
seed_low, seed_high = wide_scores.min().item(), wide_scores.max().item()
seed_sd = wide_scores.std().item()
print(wide_scores)
print(seed_low, seed_high, seed_sd)
```

The ten validation [accuracies](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/metrics.html#def-accuracy) run from `r sprintf("%.3f", py$seed_low)` to `r sprintf("%.3f", py$seed_high)`,
with standard deviation `r sprintf("%.3f", py$seed_sd)`.
Only the seed changed between the runs.
It sets the starting weights and the order of the [minibatches](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-minibatch).
So two runs can differ by about `r sprintf("%.2f", py$seed_high - py$seed_low)` in validation [accuracy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/metrics.html#def-accuracy)
with every [hyperparameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/model-selection.html#sec-hyperparameters) the same.

:::
